notes.title: Railroad to the Next Update
notes.notes: [p]G’day! everyone[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Have you been enjoying the last update, “Night Market”? It was the one where a mysterious night vendor appeared at midnight and offered a variety of unique decorative items. Oh… have you already enjoyed it to the fullest and now feel like you need something new? Perfect timing then — today we’re here to share a little about the next update that will be coming soon.[/p][p align="start"]In particular, this update will introduce a new type of vehicle and also bring changes to the farm animal system. Since this isn’t just about decorative items, it may even change the way you play the game~! In addition, we’re working on improvements to multiplayer stability and various quality-of-life features based on the feedback you’ve been sending us.[/p][p align="start"]So, shall we take a look at some of the new content first?[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]New Contents[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/c1a3ee785f2ffc7599bc0adfe40c0de9342c9f86.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]The first thing we’d like to show you is the new vehicle — the train. Dinkum already has many types of vehicles, but this train has a unique feature. To run, it needs proper tracks! (Just like in real life… haha.) Of course, you can place the train on areas without tracks, but it won’t be able to move![/p][p align="start"]Even with that limitation, the train is the fastest ground vehicle added so far. If the conditions allow, you’ll be able to run from one end of your island to the other without much trouble. We hope you’ll enjoy designing your island in even more creative ways with the train and tracks.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/5324f72c69769d3edbaaf9224977708fbead95e2.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"]A new farm animal is also being added. Its cute appearance, resembling a bandicoot, is quite charming! In addition, there will be some new animals with a somewhat familiar appearance. Details on how to obtain and use these new animals will be shared later in the patch notes when the update goes live. Beyond that, a new system related to farm animals is also on the way, so we ask for your interest and excitement![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/23fe1f301f66a28de19884fc9e1c56207c6b7336.jpg"][/img][/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Multiplayer and QoL Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Beyond new content, we are continuing to address long-standing issues that have persisted over time. Multiplayer inconveniences, in particular, have been among the most frequently reported and are a challenge we take very seriously. In this update, improvements to both performance and network quality will be made through a Unity engine update, and we’re looking forward to delivering a more stable and improved online play experience.[/p][p align="start"]Additionally, we’re incorporating other quality-of-life enhancements inspired by your feedback. These improvements are all about making gameplay smoother and ensuring you really notice the difference in your play environment.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Future Updates and Development Direction[/b][/h3][p align="start"]The update we’ve been talking about is targeted for release in October. Naturally, updates for Dinkum will continue beyond that. While nothing is finalized yet, discussions on new content and system improvements are ongoing. We’ve been exploring ideas like new terrain, maps, vehicles, tools, NPCs, and plenty of other fun things we believe you’ll enjoy.[/p][p align="start"]Rather than only showing finished results, we want to be more transparent by sharing the ideas and progress we’re working on. Moving forward, we aim to connect with you more often and more actively. For example, the character Mossy, who recently began streaming on Discord using screen sharing, is part of these efforts. Please see this as another way we’re making sure Dinkum continues to be something we build together with the community.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Since today’s post is just a small preview ahead of the official reveal of the next update, we weren’t able to share everything at once. We hope you’ll understand. Work on the update is moving forward each week, and once preparations are complete, we’ll share a more detailed preview in the form of patch notes.[/p][p align="start"]Your love and feedback are the driving force behind Dinkum’s growth. We’re always grateful for your support and will be back with you again soon. Until then, we hope you all enjoy your time![/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][/p][p align="start"][b]See you in the game, Hooroo~![/b][/p]

notes.title: Official Launch Update Hot Fix
notes.notes:
G’day! Hello, everyone!

We would like to share the details of the hotfix released on April 23, which addresses issues related to the official launch update.

While many players showed great excitement and support following the official launch update, we sincerely apologize to those who experienced difficulties due to various bugs and errors in the game.

Based on community feedback and internal review conducted after the update, we have prioritized and addressed several key issues in this hotfix. We will continue to listen to your feedback and strive to provide a better gameplay experience.

Please see below for detailed information regarding the hotfix:


[b][h3]Hotfix Schedule:[/h3][/b]
[list][*]April 24, 2025 – 10:30 (UTC)
[*]No downtime required.
[*]If you are currently playing the game, you may continue without interruption. However, to experience the updated gameplay with the applied fixes, we recommend exiting the game and installing the latest update before launching it again.[/list]

[b][h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3][/b]
[list][*] Fixed a bug that made cocoons disappear when it was added to the inventory
[*] Fixed a bug that did not give default permissions for Farm animals when a new player connects.
[list][*] Host players will need to give these permissions to anyone that has played before this fix by clicking the cog next to the player’s name on the options tab of the journal.
[/list][*] Fixed an issue that caused adult Vombats to freeze in place, and cause them to appear in different locations in multiplayer
[*] Fixed an issue that caused White Boomers to appear in Capture Requests on the Bulletin Board
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed Deeds to be deleted in creative mode
[*] Fixed a bug that occasionally caused birds to disappear mid flight when being chased
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the Pontoon item recipe from being in the recipe unlocks pool
[*] Fixed a bug that caused farm animal to appear dirty even after cleaning them
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Villagers from following the player into the mine elevator after a Town Bell has been built on the island
[/list]

[b][h3]Changes:[/h3][/b]
[list][*] When fed honey, Bug Terrariums will produce at least one cocoon a day, regardless of the type of bugs inside. Butterflies, Moths and Spiders still have a higher chance of creating cocoons
[*] Changed 2 alternate recipes for the Bug Terrarium to be consistent with the main one.
[list][*] (The alternate recipes required 3 Bee Houses, but now only require 1)
[/list][*] The Animal Shower will now turn on if an animal walks through it, regardless if they are dirty or not.
[*] The Animal Shower will turn on if a player walks through it.
[*] Improved the reliability of Scarecrows scaring birds away
[*] Rayne now sells Scarecrows, both in the visitor tent and her store
[*] Villagers will get scared and not want to leave the elevator when it stops in the Hot Hot Hot
[/list]

See you in the game~ Hooroo~!

notes.title: Dinkum Demo Version Release Announcement
notes.notes:
*2025.04.23 Update – Multiplayer section edited


G'day, everyone!

To celebrate the official launch of Dinkum on April 23rd, we're also releasing a demo version! We're excited to release this demo so that even more future adventurers can discover what makes Dinkum so special. The demo offers a taste of the full Dinkum experience. If you have friends who are still on the fence about Dinkum, now's a great time to introduce them and get them in the game!

Scroll down for more details about the demo!


[b][h2]Dinkum Demo FAQ[/h2][/b]
[b]Q: Is the content different between the demo and the full game?[/b]
[list][*]A: The core gameplay is the same, but the demo includes the following limitations:
[*]You can only play up to one in-game month. After that, you won't be able to load that save file again.
[*]Only one save slot is available for the demo.
Creative Mode and developer commands are disabled in the demo.
[/list][b]Q: Can I play multiplayer in the demo?[/b]
[list][*]A: Multiplayer is not available in the demo version.
[/list][b]Q: Can I keep playing the demo after one in-game month?[/b]
[list][*]A: You'll need to delete your current save and start over. Purchasing the full game removes this restriction.
[/list][b]Q: If I buy the full game, can I continue from my demo save?[/b]
[list][*]A: Yes! You can continue your progress by loading your demo save file in the full game. Just make sure to install the full game after purchase.
[/list][b]However, in the following cases, your saved data may not be retained.[/b]
[list][*]If Steam Cloud is not enabled, or if your save file is stored only on your PC (local device) and you uninstall Dinkum from your Steam library, the save file will be deleted.
[*]If there is no save file left on Steam Cloud or your PC (local device), you will not be able to continue your previous progress even after repurchasing Dinkum.
[*]You can check whether Steam Cloud is enabled by following the path below:
[list][*]Steam Library → Dinkum → Manage → Properties → General tab[/list][/list]


If you want to chat about the game, come hang out on our [url=https://discord.gg/dinkum]Discord[/url] full of Dinkum discussions~


See you all in the game~! Hooroo!

notes.title: Dinkum OST Release and Bundle Announcement
notes.notes:
G’day! Hello, everyone!

While playing the game, you may have found yourself humming along to the background music without even realizing it. Dinkum features a variety of music that matches every situation — sometimes calm, sometimes upbeat. To celebrate the official launch, we are releasing the Dinkum OST so you can enjoy the music even when you're not logged into the game.

The Dinkum OST was produced by Satsuma Audio, known for creating soundtracks for games like Selaco and Warbits. This soundtrack features 41 tracks, including 'Fair Dinkum!' — the music you hear when the game first launches — as well as themes for various villager NPCs. Now, you can enjoy Dinkum’s music anytime, anywhere.

You can find the Dinkum OST in the DLC section of the Steam store. To celebrate the official launch, we’re holding a special discount event, so we hope you’ll check it out!

notes.title: Official Launch Update Patch Notes Preview
notes.notes:
*2025.04.22 Update – Removed note stating pergolas can be placed overlapping


G'day, everyone!

Here are the patch notes for the long-awaited official launch update! Packed with new things to play with, this update makes the world of Dinkum more vibrant and enriching. It's the perfect time to invite your mates over to your island and enjoy all the new fun together! You can even take them on a scenic ride in your two-seater plane to show off your beautiful island from above.

Along with all this new content, the update brings tons of improvements for a smoother and more stable gameplay experience. Multiplayer permissions have been refined to easily manage what your visitors can and can't do. Several quality-of-life upgrades have also been added to make your time in Dinkum even more pleasant.

Oh! To celebrate the official launch, James, our dear creator of Dinkum, has sent us a special message. Let's all give him a warm round of applause and take a look!

[hr] [/hr]

[i]G’day everyone!

It’s been nearly 3 years since I released Dinkum into early access, and nearly 8 years since I started work on developing Dinkum.

In that time Dinkum has gone from a little project on my computer, to being played by thousands of people. Players who’ve truly made the game their own.

It’s been my finest pleasure to watch people play Dinkum, to see all the creations players have made on their island and to hear the stories and memories people have made inside that little game that used to live only on my computer.

So, for that I say thank you so much for playing Dinkum.

In the 3 years of early access I’ve been adding to Dinkum, offering updates with new items, features and adventures to experience. These updates have been shaped by the excitement and passion I have received from Dinkum players, as well as the hundreds of suggestions left by the Dinkum community.

So for that I wanted to say thank you to the community that helped Dinkum make it to 1.0.

After all the updates and new content added over the years, I believe Dinkum now feels complete. So that is why I’ve decided to leave early access and officially launch Dinkum. 

This doesn’t mean the end of Dinkum, and it certainly doesn’t mean the end of updates. All this means is: Dinkum is no longer in early access.

I hope you enjoy all the new features I’ve added in this update, a lot of these features are highly requested features. Some of them were hard to implement, but I believe they were worth the effort.

Thanks for taking your time to read this message. 

And as always, thanks for playing Dinkum.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/8e4b8b892bf1cf5af54ce25690a73871e3fc5dd4.jpg[/img]

[hr] [/hr]

As always, there's nothing better than jumping straight in and trying them out for yourself. But if you want to study the details, check out the full patch notes below.


[b][h2]Update Schedule:[/h2][/b]
[list]
[*] April 23, 2025 at 02:00 (UTC)
[*] No downtime maintenance required.
[*] If you are already in the game, you can continue playing. However, to access the update content, please exit the game, install the update, and then restart the game.
[/list]


[b][h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[h3]New Features[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/74126e7a2587a777eb9adbf3c585ff728c2d0b4e.jpg[/img]
- Creative mode has been added.
[list][*] In Creative mode, players can open their inventory and access the creative toolbar.
[list][*] Players can search and add items to their inventory.
[*]Players can swap to the time / weather tab to adjust the in-game clock and weather.
[*]Players can spawn Animals into their world.[/list][*]Once switched to Creative Mode, Steam achievements will be permanently disabled for that save file, so please choose carefully. (The Steam achievement system is currently in preparation. Further details will be provided at a later date.)
[*]When selecting a save for single-player mode, players can press the cog icon to switch to default or Creative mode.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/22d097df540f41acbdfeaaf2d4d00b04b011abf3.jpg[/img]
- The Town Bell has been added.
[list][*]The Town Bell Deed is unlocked after completing the Town Hall.
[*]The Town Bell can be rung by interacting with it or hitting it with a weapon or tool

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/46b627dbd1b9007d170850ecc4dd862619571974.jpg[/img]
- Four new villagers have been added.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/b5f2ff4e7a098fd4086b944e9a1f969099a5a5e7.jpg[/img]
- A new vehicle – Plane – has been added.

[*]The plane can land and float on water.
[*]Franklyn can craft if he learns the recipe by giving him enough old discs and completing the berkonium mission (players who have met these requirements may need to offer Franklyn at least one shiny disc for him to discover the recipe).[/list]

[list][*]When the island is experiencing a heat wave, there is a chance to dig up this very valuable treasure.[/list]

[list]
[*] Villagers have their own inventory that can be accessed through a dialogue option while hanging out with them.
[*] Players can give villagers helpful tools to use while hanging out.

[*] When hanging out with a villager, they will rush over and revive the player if they’re nearby when the player is passed out. How reliable!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Villagers may change into clothing in their inventory. So be sure to think about what they would like to wear the next time they ask for some new clothing.
[/list]
- Villagers now have a new type of request.
[list]
[*] New dialogues have been added to decrease repetition for most villager requests.
[*] They may ask players to collect specific items depending on the season.
[/list]
- Villagers now have random behaviors.
[list]
[*] Villagers now behave more naturally – eating random items from their inventory, fishing in the river, or catching bugs.
[*] When villagers have conversations with each other, they may occasionally show speech bubbles or emotes. If the player is nearby, they can read the dialogue.
[/list]
- 3 new outfits have been added.

[*]Any quests that give the players a recipe (nail and crate recipes) can now be completed by visiting players.

[*]However, quests that are town/building specific can still only be undertaken by the host player (Get John to move in, Unlock the Town Hall, etc.).[/list]

[list][*]Other items / decorations can be placed under pergolas and festoons.
[*]The obstacle detection area for pergolas and festoons has been changed to the four corner tiles.
[*]Any tile under it (excluding the corners) can be decorated.[/list]

notes.title: Regarding Mod-Related Issues After Language Support Update
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! It came to our attention that some players experienced incorrect game language settings or other malfunctioning features after the update for 14 languages support.

It has been identified that these issues are highly likely to be caused by applying mods.
To resolve issues caused by applied mods, please delete any installed mod files and restart the game.

If you are facing difficulties in removing specific mod files, it is recommended to delete the [b]'BepInEx' folder[/b], which is the common installation path for mods.

Common Mod Installation Path:
[list]
[*] Local Folder for Game Installations → Steam\steamapps\common\Dinkum\BepInEx
[/list]
After deleting the 'BepInEx' folder, please restart Dinkum and check if the issue is resolved.
If the problem persists or you encounter any other issues, please do not hesitate to contact us anytime. Thank you.

※ Note: External mods are not officially compatible with Dinkum. Please kindly be aware that deleting the 'BepInEx' folder may remove all installed mod functionalities.

notes.title: Flaming Winter Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Dinkum's latest update “Flaming Winter” is live and ready to play!

If you want to go in totally blind, you can stop reading here and start playing. But for those who want a bit more detail, please keep reading.

[previewyoutube=8U9BEHPx27E;full][/previewyoutube]

When you start playing, you might notice that winter in Dinkum feels a lot cooler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/ed1989efd99bfff82bbe06ddc4f4ae2f9e88ea54.png[/img]

Snowfall can now occur in winter! Sometimes during winter, it will snow on your island instead of rain. If you get super lucky and it snows in the morning, your island will experience a snow day. On these days, snow will cover the landscape of your island, you’ll hear the snow crunching under your feet and you might even find some other unique occurrences around your island. So be sure to go exploring on a snow day. 

Snow days will be somewhat rare, but they will occur more often if you have a way to to control the rain on your island…

Now, there’s a sneak peek at the “winter” part of the update. What about the “flaming” part I hear you ask?

Well, I’d like to introduce a new level of the mines, a level even deeper than the Undergrove…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/622a846667c9c5acda2d341cd856556c047ac255.png[/img]

Welcome to the Hot Hot Hot.

This 3rd level of the mines is the most dangerous level yet. So dangerous in fact, that the peaceful wish doesn’t seem to affect its denizens.

This mine level is intended to be visited by late game players. You’ll want good gear, good food and maybe some good friends to help you explore the lava filled depths. There are large dungeon-like structures to loot for new treasure, and rare Berkonium nodes to find and return to the new Gem Crusher near the mine's entrance.

Well, I think that covers both the Flaming and the Winter parts of this update. I'll leave it up to you to discover all the other new things you can find in this update. But, if you're the type of person who needs an even more detailed breakdown, the patch notes are down below.

notes.title: The Breezy Autumn Update is Here!
notes.notes:
G’day!

Can you sense the cooler breeze on your face and notice the trees changing colours? Do you find yourself reaching for a blanket at night or an extra jumper in the early morning? Are the temperatures outside rather comfy, with the sun no longer scorching you in seconds? If you’re feeling that cooler change, it can only mean one thing: Autumn has arrived in Dinkum. And this season’s Autumn has brought along the [b]Breezy Autumn Update![/b]

[previewyoutube=ZD0ggC_mr7Y;full][/previewyoutube]
When you stroll around your island, take a look around and see how more colourful this Autumn is. The trees have changed to shades of gold and orange, and if you’re paying attention during the night, you might see [b]a new weather event[/b]. This rare event will happen more often during the Autumn and Winter seasons.

But don't just look up at the sky; take a moment to notice the [b]Mushrooms[/b] sprouting from the ground. Different varieties of mushrooms will appear across the island during autumn mornings, but they will wilt at noon. You’ll want to gather these mushrooms nice and early, so you use them to cook up [b]new food recipes[/b] or utilise them in crafting [b]new items[/b]. Who knew these tiny fungi could be so versatile?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/88b2384f3281a8a9ddc6212a8b7c6ec5158d1789.png[/img]
[i]As the nights grow chilly, there are always some ways to stay warm.[/i]

But it’s not just the weather! With this update, I’ve added some new items and quality-of-life changes that will make gameplay a lot more breezy! 

John now sells the handy [b]Hand Trolley[/b], capable of moving full containers! No need to empty containers before relocating them - convenience at its finest. In addition, building licence level 3 now gives access to the crafting recipe for the [b]Advanced Crafting Tables[/b]. These fancy new tables can pull crafting resources from nearby chests, allowing players to craft up a storm. 

Oh, and Franklyn now offers a new contraption that will make sorting items from your inventory and into containers much easier. You might need to give him a shiny disc to make him learn it, but I’ll leave that as a surprise for you to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/7066f997c2d03d51ff250e3ed9484ba9ef71c8ee.png[/img]
[i]If you're looking to lighten your workload, consider investing in a Hand Trolley.[/i]

Another big change I’m excited about is the [b]Wish Fountain[/b]. This new deed is available from the beginning of the game, so you can speak to Fletch if you want to build one on your island.

The Wish Fountain can be used to make “wishes” that change how your Dinkum island behaves. These wishes last forever, but you can only have one wish in effect at a time.

For example, you can wish for your island to be peaceful, which makes animals only attack you if you attack them. You could also wish to make your island more dangerous, but this will make animals drop twice as much loot. There are a few more wishes, but I’ll let you discover them for yourself.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/1a9efc155254f8074895e38b64162dae2d9bfe6b.png[/img]
[i]What will you wish for?[/i]

This is just a taste of some of the new content that’s available to you with the new update. There is a new seasonal event that appears in Autumn if you have a Band Stand on your island. There is also a new stamina system, new fish, bugs, crops, clothing, and crafting recipes to discover.  

Download the Breezy Autumn Update now and see what changes and additions you can find! And if you want to know the full list of them, check the changelog below. And as always, let me know your thoughts and comments below!

Have fun playing and speak to you soon!

James



[b]New:[/b]

- Autumn is now much more colourful!
- There is a new seasonal event - Sky Fest. This event is held at the Band Stand in Autumn and includes new and items to collect and games to play.
- Added a new Deed - The “Wish Fountain”, this deed allows players to change the rules of the game in exchange for some Dinks.
- Added a Peaceful wish, made at Wish Fountain that prevents animals from attacking, unless they are attacked.
- Added 3 more wishes that change other aspects of the game.
- Different mushrooms will spawn around the island on autumn mornings but are only harvestable until noon.
- Reworked the stamina system to encourage cooking and eating better food.
- A new, rare weather event can happen on some nights, more common in Autumn and Winter.

[b]Improvements and Changes:[/b]

- The wandering hunter will now only visit after 3:00 pm on Saturdays, unless certain wishes are in effect.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.1 - A message about save files
notes.notes:
Hi there. I just wanted to let you know that I am aware that some players have been having issues with saving and loading their games.

Since releasing Dinkum I have paid as much care as possible to keeping player’s saves throughout the entire Early Access period. This always has been and continues to be very important to me.

For the Summer Sun Update we made a lot of changes to the internal of Dinkum, including writing a new save system. The old system was very bloated - it had far too many separate files and often caused problems with Steam Cloud syncs. The new system is much smaller, taking the file amount down from around 60 files to just 3.

The Summer Sun update was tested publicly for over three weeks, this was in part due to my concerns with the new save system. Over those 3 weeks, a lot of bugs were reported, but no issues were found relating to players using the new save system.

However, since the public release, some rare cases of save file corruption have been reported. For anyone that has experienced this I would like to sincerely apologize. I know how much some player’s islands mean to them and I can not express my regret enough.

I have been working tirelessly on improving the new save system and I’ve included these changes in this hotfix. I am hopeful that these changes will mitigate any further problems.

Once again, I apologize if your save was affected by these changes.

I hope this hotfix prevents these kinds of problems in future.

Thank you everyone for your understanding and patience,

James

First up, get ready to pack your bags and head over to the brand-new AeroTours Airport! When you're in need of a soul-soothing vacation or an exciting new journey, there's no better place to go. [i]Summer is tailor-made for beach parties. [/i]

Dust off your trusty fishing rod and start practising, because the angler who reels in the most fish will claim the top spot. And who knows what the prize might be…

Also, a little heads up. Get ready to stay one step ahead of the weather, regardless of the season you find yourself in. With this latest update, we’ve introduced a dynamic weather system that brings day-to-day weather changes to your adventures. Oh, and remember to seek shelter from that scorching summer sun! The Heatwave, a new weather event will show just how hot Dinkum Island can get now.

With the Summer Sun update, you will also get a new fruit, a tasty new crop, a new weapon, stylish furniture, trendy clothing, and lots, lots more. Dive into the game and explore all these fantastic additions right away. I’ve also increased the number of players that can now play to six, so if you have a couple more friends who want to explore your Dinkum island together, now you can. And if you're craving more details, check the changelog below.

And finally, now that the Summer Sun update is out, I’ll be slowly getting ready for the final 1.0 Dinkum release. Don’t worry though, as I have a lot more ideas for new content for you before the big final release. I’ll tell you all about it soon, but in the meantime, enjoy the new update. And as always, tell me what you think of it too. I love hearing all the feedback from you all.


Speak to you soon!

- James

I’ve been working on new Dinkum content for quite some time, and I am now happy to announce that the second major Dinkum update is ready for you to play! With the [b]Bloomin’ Spring update[/b] a new resident is joining our community, some new wildflowers will spring up on the Island, you can build a new building in your town, dive deeper into the deep min, and many more surprises that I left here and there for you to find. If you want to know more details about what’s coming to Dinkum, keep on reading. But if you don’t want to spoil the fun of discovery, you can jump into your Dinkum island and find the surprises yourself. Whatever option you choose, I hope you enjoy all the new content. [previewyoutube=YwlNtbXORTQ;full][/previewyoutube]
You’re still here? In that case, let me tell you more about the Bloomin’ Spring update. From today you can say hello and become friends with [b]Sheila[/b], our new villager on Dinkum Island. You can find her at your local Visitor Site. Sheila loves food and her hobby is cooking. She is known to make some tasty tucker. If you want her to move permanently to your town, you’re going to have to cook up some treats for her. Sheila is the owner of [b]Tuckerbox[/b], a local tuckshop. [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/196f42347ae2a1630e966e6dbe158aa473d8f019.png[/img]

[i]Can’t wait to see what events we can have here![/i]

Are you looking for a way to organize your town a little bit better? Perhaps making it easier to navigate? Or perhaps you would like to commemorate some special places? Well from now on you can place [b]signs[/b] which you can use to mark directions, highlight spots, or just to upgrade the look of the town’s street. Before you can place them, speak to Fletch first and get a Sign Writing Licence – thanks to that licence you will get The Sign Writing Table, a pen, and a few sign recipes. With these, you can start putting signs anywhere you like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35352186/eed969c012f40341551d658b9db8d97db6b12a1e.png[/img]
[i]Is it possible to have too many signs?[/i]

Well, there's a sneak peek, but I’ll leave you with the fun of discovering all the other new additions. There’s plenty of new stuff that isn’t mentioned here, but if you really, really, really want to know more, check out the changelog below. And before I go, I just want to thank you all for all your help, your comments, feedback, and support. You have no idea how much it means to me to get such positivity from all of you. So once again, thank you and I really hope you like the new update! 

Speak to you all soon,
James

G’day everyone,

Today is the day that you can enjoy brand-new Dinkum content as the [b]House Warming update is here![/b] While the update is downloading, let me tell you a little bit more about it.

One of the first updates you will come across is a [b]new wild animal - The Frilly[/b]. They are inspired by one of my favourite native Australian creatures. You will find Frillies roaming around in the desert biome. But be careful around them! These fellas are fast and if provoked, they will fight back! They have a very quick bite and another surprise if you make them angry enough. Next up on the new content list are the new [b]Guest Houses[/b]. From now on you will be able to add up to three of them on your island. You can use them as a place to store all your crops and farming materials in one place, or maybe you need a house for all your hats? Better yet, they can be a place for your friends to stay when they come and visit your island. So build a few and make your friends feel at home. The deeds for these will be offered by Fletch once you’ve upgraded your tent into a house. I am sure you will find a great use for them!

Thanks to your comments and suggestions, I’ve also added the ability to key-bind up to two different keys per action. However, rebinding for gamepads is something that needs a bit more time, sorry! I want to make Dinkum as accessible as it can be for all players, so I will continue to make these kinds of changes.

There are a bunch of other new items, recipes and secrets to track down in this update as well. I wanted the first update to be a bit bigger than what was on the road map, so I hope you all enjoy it. notes.title: Dinkum's Release Date Announced! New trailer to celebrate the occasion.
notes.notes:
G’day mate,

The work on this game has been progressing for over 3 years now. I’m sure many things happened during this time in your life - just as many have happened to me. But one thing is certain: Dinkum will be released really, really soon, and I’m excited for it!

Better start thinking about the name of your island cause [b]Dinkum will be released on the 14th of July 2022![/b] Watch the trailer and see the latest of what Dinkum has to offer!

[previewyoutube=50cl6ZxI2ts;full][/previewyoutube]
I’m very excited about this next step for Dinkum. And I have to admit I can’t wait to see what you’ll create on your islands and for you to play it! 

Dinkum will be coming out in Early Access, and although there will be quite a lot to do from day one, I feel that there is still a lot more that I can implement in the game - more gameplay features, content, options, objects to decorate your island with, and more. I also wanted to go the Early Access route so that you can tell me what you would like to see more of in Dinkum and the direction the game should take. I really want to hear your thoughts on this once the game is out.

Ooo, and one more thing, Dinkum has its own Discord server. If you want to join our still small, but truly amazing community, please do it! It’ll be a pleasure to have you there.

Have a good one,

James Bendon
